chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey – Chapter 425: Breaking the Final Restriction
chapter_meta_description: Han Li and Shi Die finally dismantle the ancient formation after three months, only to face its last fiery layer swarming with soul-eating Fiend Wings. Team deployment begins.
og_description: Three months of painstaking effort boil down to one final restriction: a blazing barrier of soul-eating Fiend Wings.
twitter_description: Han Li and Shi Die finish their calculations—now it’s time to break the last seal, a fiery nest of deadly fire spirits.

lore_anchors.definition: Fire element spirits born from extreme Yang energy; they have very short lifespans (hours) but can be continuously reborn in formations designed as a “Three Yang” location. They devour souls and spit powerful demonic fire.
A rare, often man-made terrain configuration that concentrates Yang-type energy to extreme levels, enabling the continuous generation of fire elementals like the Fiend Wings.
A practitioner’s mental/spiritual perception. It can be blocked, repelled, or even damaged by certain magical formations and barriers.

cultural_notes_faq.a: They are rare fire element spirits born in a “Three Yang” terrain; they die in hours but are continuously reborn by the formation, spitting flames comparable to a cultivator’s Nascent Flame and devouring souls.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li defer to Shi Die on the formation?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He admits his own theoretical knowledge is inferior to hers—she is a genuine formation expert—so he lets her handle deduction while he supplies practical destruction techniques.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is this the end of the expedition?
cultural_notes_faq.a: No—this is just the last barrier. The stone pillar within has not yet been examined, and the true purpose of the ruins remains unknown.
